# PROTEGEY Secures Pre-Seed Funding to Expand Fraud Intelligence Across Africa
Founded by CEO Amadou Diallo and CTO Ndeme Yvan, the company is building an AI-powered risk platform and a cross-border shared fraud intelligence network that enables institutions to track threats without exchanging raw customer data.

Founded by Chief Executive Officer Amadou Diallo and Chief Technology Officer Ndeme Yvan, PROTEGEY is developing an artificial intelligence-driven platform that integrates identity verification, fraud prevention, risk management, and regulatory compliance tools for financial institutions.
